title: Scalar endomorphism on the restricted coherent coefficient
statement: Let j:Y to X be etale, G a quasicoherent O_X-module with quasicoherent tensor pullback along j, and r a global function on Y. Define restrictionScalar(j,G,r) on the inverse image of the lifted coherent etale sheaf of G to be coherentEtaleRestrictionIso(j,G).hom, followed by coherentEtaleMap of multiplication by r on the tensor pullback of G, followed by coherentEtaleRestrictionIso(j,G).inv. This is a specified composite, not a choice of an endomorphism with an unproved property. Dependencies: [def-weil-pbc-coherent-etale-restriction], [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes].

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images, restriction of cohomology classes; Descent Tag 03DR, tensor-section restriction.

proof.text: Take the displayed composite of the two maps of the fixed coherent restriction isomorphism and coherentEtaleMap applied to smulHom r. Its source and target coincide, so it is the required endomorphism. No existence or uniqueness assertion is needed to define this composite.

proof_origin.place: Scalar naturality expansion of the presheaf in Tag 03Q8; tensor-section normalization from Tag 03DR.
